description: Access IPOSignal's proprietary market sentiment score — a daily signal quantifying how well recent IPOs are being received by investors. Ranges from -100 (extreme bearish) to +100 (extreme bullish) with trend data for the last N days. Use it to identify favorable IPO windows, time investment entries, and assess overall market appetite for new listings. PREMIUM: paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base); an unpaid call returns the payment terms, and a not-found is never charged. Same data and price as the HTTP endpoint /api/agent/ipo-sentiment.

days.description: Trend window in days, 1-90. Defaults to 14.

name: get_ipo_sentiment

computedAt.description: When the score was computed, ISO 8601.

date.description: Day the score is for, YYYY-MM-DD.

reliable.description: False when sampleSize is below 5: too few IPOs to trust the score.

sampleSize.description: How many recent IPOs the score is computed from.

score.description: -100 (extremely bearish) to +100 (extremely bullish). Built from how recent IPOs traded in their first 30 days: the level over the last 30 days and its change against the last 60.

summary.description: One sentence: the level, the direction over the last 7 days, and the sample size.

trend.description: Daily scores for the window you asked for, newest first.

title: IPO market sentiment score (premium)
